preservation.review: The editor retained the composition, Pepe, ancestral marks, warm rock, cracks, torchlight, and framing while adding a lower-left charcoal path and two ochre stones. Its raster output changes fine texture globally, so pixel identity outside the added mark is not claimed.

review: Inspected the full PNG and 512-pixel JPEG. Pepe remains a wide-mouthed, heavy-lidded cave frog with the two inherited visible five-digit hands; no new hands or handprints were added. No letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, real people, political symbols, or hateful symbols were observed.
